client.industry_secondary: Women's health services (OB-GYN, telehealth, ancillary care)
client.business_model: Multi-site women's health provider operating OB-GYN clinics, ancillary service lines and a telehealth platform across several U.S. states
client.client_history: Founded in 2014 in Arlington, Virginia by Sean Glass, Advantia Health has grown through acquisitions such as Heartland Women’s Healthcare and Pacify to more than 60 women’s health clinics and a nationwide telehealth offering. The company received growth investments from Deerfield Management (2016) and a $45 million round led by BlueMountain Capital Management in 2020 to accelerate expansion.

revenue.notes: Publicly available estimates vary widely: Zippia – $13.0 M, Growjo – $22.4 M, Buzzfile – $29.1 M, CanvasBusinessModel – $89 M (likely inflated). Buzzfile/D&B data is generally more reliable than employment-based extrapolations; reported range $13–29 M, using Buzzfile’s $29.1 M as highest credible point but overall confidence remains low.

locations.source: Prnewswire release on Heartland acquisition & company overview page (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/advantia-health-expands-nationally-with-acquisition-of-heartland-womens-healthcare-300798460.html; https://theindex.work/companies/advantia-health)
locations.notes: Both sources state Advantia operates ‘over 60 OB-GYN and coordinated specialist offices’. No exact count published on official site; treated 60 as midpoint.

employees.notes: LeadIQ lists 501 employees (Dec 2025). Supporting sources show 500–1,000 range (Indeed, SignalHire) and 259 (Buzzfile). Majority of sources cluster around 500+, so 501 selected.
